##### Project general facts

This contemporary residential community within Expo City Dubai offers a lifestyle where urban convenience meets eco-conscious design. Surrounded by landscaped courtyards and thoughtfully designed architecture, the development creates a peaceful, pedestrian-friendly environment where everything is within easy walking distance. Expansive views of Expo City and its iconic landmarks enhance the living experience, combining modern city energy with a calm, nature-oriented setting.

The community is set within over 45,000 square meters of parks and green spaces, designed to promote wellbeing and sustainability. As one of the first developments aligned with the WELL Community Standard pilot, it prioritizes health, comfort, and environmental balance. Residents can enjoy jogging tracks, cycling paths, and nature trails, along with access to clubhouses, swimming pools, and fully equipped gyms, creating a well-rounded and active lifestyle.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and private balconies that bring natural light into the homes. Clean lines and a contemporary design approach create a bright and comfortable living environment. The kitchens are equipped with white goods, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Expo City Dubai stands as a testament to the visionary ambitions of Dubai, a city known for its grandeur and cutting-edge development projects. At the core of Expo City Dubai is the anticipation and preparation for hosting one of the world's most significant events—the World Expo.

Expo City Dubai is designed to be the epicenter of the World Expo, an international event that gathers countries from around the globe to showcase innovations, ideas, and advancements. The venue is meticulously planned to accommodate the diverse needs of participants and visitors, offering state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities.

The architecture of Expo City Dubai is a breathtaking blend of modernity and cultural elements. Iconic structures and pavilions rise against the skyline, each telling a story of the participating nations' unique contributions. The cityscape is a visual feast, celebrating innovation and human achievement.
